caveats: ⛑ TARGET PROXY: both ally-facing blocks are scoped to a SPECIFIC NAMED ally ('her favorite pop star'). The schema has no named-slug TargetDef, so they are authored as alliesTopAtk count 1 excludeSelf. This is a PROXY, not the kit: it (a) may pick the wrong ally, and (b) still buffs someone on a team where the real named ally is ABSENT, where the true kit grants ZERO. Highest-magnitude uncertainty in this file.

⛑ Aftershow duration: the kit bounds it by an EVENT ('removed when entering Full Burst'), not a clock. No removeOnFullBurstEnter primitive exists, so durationSec 10 stands in for the out-of-Full-Burst window. Over-long bleeds the +50% FB major onto a buff the kit strips at FB entry (over-credit); 10s is chosen deliberately short.

Stargazer is a SELF status with no schema representation (requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped). Its lifecycle is exactly burst-cast → status → that rotation's FB entry → stripped at FB end, so skill2 is keyed fullBurstEnter + ownBurstGate:'cast'. This is faithful only while she bursts on the rotation she buffs; it under-fires if a Stargazer instance ever survives a Full Burst.

'continuously' on the skill2 pair is read as PERMANENT (no durationSec) from the first qualifying FB entry. If the real behaviour is FB-window-scoped, this over-credits every out-of-FB second after the first burst.
The >25% HP condition on skill2's self-cost line is not gated: v1 has no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so the condition is unconditionally true and the gate would be inert either way.
The heal models the RECOVERY EVENTS only (10 ticks, 1s apart) so on-recovery consumers fire; the 3.52%-of-final-Max-HP amount is not modeled because the engine tracks no HP pool.
casterMaxHpPct 26.4 is offensively INERT here — avistar carries no atkOfMaxHpPct converter — and is retained for kit completeness / future consumers.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⛑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. MG/Electric/Supporter/Burst I. Avistar deals no kit damage: her entire offensive contribution is two buff packages routed at ONE specific named ally ('her favorite pop star') plus a Burst Stage 1 re-entry. skill1 fires at Full Burst END (Aftershow, caster-scaled flat ATK, stripped at the next FB entry) and self-heals 10 ticks. skill2 fires at Full Burst ENTRY on rotations she bursted (the Stargazer state proxy), granting a permanent 40.13% Projectile Explosion + 40.13% Attack Damage pair to the same ally — note the pair is only worth its full value on a projectile-explosion carrier. The burst grants self Max HP (Stargazer) and re-opens Burst Stage 1 for a second B1 caster. Three fields are unresolvable from the text alone: the named-ally target, the event-bounded Aftershow duration, and the Stargazer status lifecycle.

flags.reasoning: 'her favorite pop star' names ONE specific ally. TargetDef has no named-slug kind, so no faithful encoding exists. A single-ally proxy at least preserves the magnitude scope (one recipient, not four); {kind:'allies'} would multiply an 80.26%-caster-ATK grant plus a 40.13/40.13 pair across the whole team. The proxy is still wrong in two ways: it can select the wrong ally, and on a team WITHOUT the named unit the true kit grants nothing while the proxy still grants everything.
flags.recipe: Resolve the named ally from the game's kit tooltip / the unit's release material, then either (a) add a TargetDef {kind:'allySlug', slug:'<x>'} to types.ts, or (b) keep alliesTopAtk count 1 and add a block-level teamHas:{slugs:['<x>']} gate so the block goes inert without that ally. Confirm empirically by recording one fight with the named ally present and one without — avistar's buffs must be worth ZERO in the second.

flags.reasoning: The kit bounds Aftershow by an EVENT: applied at Full Burst END, removed at the next Full Burst ENTRY. That window is the entire out-of-FB stretch of one rotation — roughly the ~2.5s post-FB delay + gauge refill + the ~1.5s B1→B2→B3→FB chain, i.e. very roughly 10-13s on a 20s-cooldown rotation. 10 is chosen at the SHORT end on purpose: an over-long window lets the buff survive into Full Burst, where the +50% FB major and the team's other buffs are live, so the error is amplified exactly where the kit says the buff should not exist.
flags.recipe: Preferred: add a removeOnFullBurstEnter flag to the buff effect (mirror of removeOnReload) and drop durationSec entirely — that is the faithful primitive. Interim measurement: run a graded comp with ROT=1, read the FB-end → next-FB-enter gap per rotation off the rotation log, and set durationSec to that measured gap; verify via a buffApply expiresFrame check in scripts/tests/units/avistar.test.ts that the buff never overlaps a fullBurstStart event.

flags.reasoning: Stargazer is granted by her own burst and removed at Full Burst end, so it is alive for exactly one FB entry per rotation she bursts — which is what fullBurstEnter + ownBurstGate:'cast' expresses. A bare fullBurstEnter would over-fire on any rotation she did not burst. The proxy fails only if a Stargazer instance can survive a Full Burst (e.g. a rotation where she bursts but no Full Burst follows, leaving the status live into the NEXT rotation's FB entry) — the kit text does not settle that case.
flags.recipe: Confirm from footage that the 40.13% pair never appears on a rotation avistar did not burst, and that it does appear on every rotation she did. If a surviving-Stargazer case is observed, the right fix is a real self-status primitive (a self-scoped analogue of targetStatus/requiresTargetStatus) rather than a gate.

flags.estimate: absent (permanent from the first qualifying Full Burst entry)
flags.reasoning: 'continuously' carries no duration and, unlike the Aftershow line, no removal clause — read as no time expiry. Same-caster-slot overwrite makes the per-FB re-application a no-op, so the practical shape is: off before her first burst, on for the rest of the fight. If the intended shape is instead FB-window-only, this over-credits every out-of-FB second from the first burst onward, which on a 180s fight is the majority of the timeline.
flags.recipe: Read the buff icon on the recipient across an FB boundary in footage: if the 40.13% pair persists after the Full Burst ends, permanent is correct; if it drops, set durationSec to the FB window length (and note it would then also need the FB-entry re-application to be exact).

flags.estimate: recovery EVENTS modeled (10 × 1s); the 3.52%-of-final-Max-HP magnitude is not
flags.reasoning: The engine's heal effect carries no HP quantity by design (no HP pool, immortal boss). The line is kept rather than skipped because heal lines are non-skippable under the tandem rule — the 10 recovery events keep any on-recovery consumer (crown-style 'when recovery takes effect') refreshed, and the tick count is what drives that, not the amount. Target is SELF, so within avistar's own kit it feeds nothing; its value is entirely cross-unit.
flags.recipe: No measurement needed while no HP pool exists. If an HP pool is ever modeled, restore the 3.52% × final Max HP per tick; until then assert only the recovery event count (10) in scripts/tests/units/avistar.test.ts.
